requestwiki-label-nsfw: This wiki includes content that is not safe for work (NSFW)
requestwiki-help-nsfw: A wiki includes content that not safe for work (NSFW) if it includes graphic discussion or imagery of sex, gore or violence (either text or media content) or content which is otherwise inappropriate for those under the age of 18.
requestwiki-label-nsfwtext: Please give us more details about the type of NSFW content that your wiki will contain
requestwiki-label-nsfw-primary: This wiki primarily focuses on content that is not safe for work (NSFW)
requestwiki-help-nsfw-primary: A wiki primarily focuses on NSFW content if its main scope covers material usually marked as NSFW (a book, movies, games, etc), is a wiki where most content itself is NSFW, or otherwise focuses on content which would typically fall under an age confirmation or separation in casual settings. It does not mean cases where the wiki occasionally covers NSFW material as part of a larger work or subject.
requestwiki-label-source: This wiki is migrating or forking from an existing wiki/platform
requestwiki-label-sourceurl: Enter the full URL of the source wiki (the wiki you are moving or forking from)
sitenotice-wiki-closed: This wiki has been automatically [[meta:Dormancy Policy|closed]] because there have been no edits or log actions made within the last 120 days. If you are a bureaucrat on this wiki, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck the "Closed" box to reopen it; otherwise, if you wish for this wiki to be reopened, please request to reopen it at [[meta:Steward requests|Steward requests]]. If this wiki is not reopened within 4 months, it may be deleted.
sitenotice-wiki-closed-locked: This wiki has been closed because [[meta:Stewards|Stewards]] or [[meta:Safety|Safety]] have determined that it violates WikiOasis' [[meta:Content Policy|Content Policy]] or other global policies. Bureaucrats should have received either an email or talk page message with more information, including how to appeal.
sitenotice-wiki-closed-private: This wiki has been automatically [[meta:Dormancy Policy|closed]] because there have been no edits or log actions made within the last 120 days. If you are a bureaucrat on this wiki, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck the "Closed" box to reopen it; since the wiki is private, it cannot be reopened any other way. If this wiki is not reopened within 4 months, it may be deleted.
sitenotice-wiki-inactive: This wiki has had no edits or log actions made within the last 90 days and has been automatically marked as inactive. If you would like to prevent this wiki from being closed, please start showing signs of activity here; if you are a bureaucrat, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck "Inactive" yourself. If there are no signs of this wiki being used within the next 30 days, this wiki will be closed in accordance to the [[meta:Dormancy Policy|Dormancy Policy]] (which all wiki founders accept when requesting a wiki). If this wiki is closed and no one reopens it 150 days from now, this wiki will become eligible for deletion.
shortdescription-desc: Allows you to add short descriptions to wiki pages
embedvideo-desc: Allows you to embed videos into your pages
tiff-desc: Allows you to upload and display tiff files
mediaspoiler-desc: Allows you to add spoilers to media files on pages
pdf-desc: An easy way to upload and view PDFs on your wiki
simplebatchupload-desc: A simple way to batch upload files

wikioasis-spring-step-welcome-desc: A few questions to get the important settings right. It takes about 2-3 minutes.
wikioasis-spring-step-route: How would you like to set up?
wikioasis-spring-step-route-desc: Start from a template, or choose everything yourself.
wikioasis-spring-step-template: What sort of wiki is this?
wikioasis-spring-step-template-desc: Pick the closest match and we will apply the best settings for it.
wikioasis-spring-step-visibility-desc: This can be changed at any time afterwards.
wikioasis-spring-step-editing-desc: Choose how open editing should be. You can always adjust individual permissions later.
wikioasis-spring-step-extensions-desc: Popular choices are listed at the top, you can search for anything else.
wikioasis-spring-step-skins-desc: Skins change how your wiki looks. Pick the ones to offer and which one readers will see by default.
wikioasis-spring-step-styling-desc: Give your wiki its own look.
wikioasis-spring-step-options-desc: A few commonly used settings. Leave anything you are unsure about as it is.
wikioasis-spring-step-import-desc: Optional. Choose a set of templates and other pages to be imported into your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-step-share-desc: Your wiki is ready. Tell people it exists.
wikioasis-spring-step-finish-desc: Your wiki is ready. Here are some suitable next steps for you.
wikioasis-spring-flow-template-desc: Pick the sort of wiki you are making and we will choose sensible settings for it.
wikioasis-spring-flow-manual-desc: Go through each option and decide for yourself.
wikioasis-spring-flow-quick-desc: Set basic settings such as visibility and who can edit, the rest is left stock default.
wikioasis-spring-visibility-public-desc: Anyone can read your wiki, and search engines can index it.
wikioasis-spring-visibility-private-desc: Only members you approve can read your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-editing-anon-desc: Visitors can edit without creating an account. Best for open and public wikis.
wikioasis-spring-editing-accounts-desc: Anyone can create an account and edit. This is how many wikis work, and can help to prevent spam.
wikioasis-spring-editing-approved-desc: Only people you add to the editor group can edit. Everyone else can read.
wikioasis-spring-template-general-desc: Open to readers, editable by anyone with an account.
wikioasis-spring-template-private-desc: Readable and editable only by members you approve.
wikioasis-spring-styling-logo-help: A URL to an image, you may need to upload it first to your wiki, then come back here.
wikioasis-spring-styling-favicon-help: The small icon shown in browser tabs. Usually a square version of your logo.
wikioasis-spring-styling-wordmark-help: An image of your wiki's name, shown instead of plain text by some skins.
wikioasis-spring-styling-skin-help: The skin readers see unless they choose another in their preferences.
wikioasis-spring-next-recentchanges-desc: Recent changes shows every change to your wiki in real time.
wikioasis-spring-next-userrights-desc: Give other people permissions to help you run your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-next-managewiki-desc: Everything the wizard just set-up can be changed at Special:ManageWiki.
wikioasis-spring-template-companion-desc: A wiki about a topic with its own community off-wiki
wikioasis-spring-template-standalone-des: A wiki where the community is on the wiki
wikioasis-spring-template-standalone-bul: Extensions for article styling and discussions
wikioasis-spring-import-article-desc: Some templates and infoboxes for writing articles
wikioasis-spring-welcome-body:
Welcome to '''{{SITENAME}}''', your new wiki on WikiOasis.

This wizard helps you get started with configuring your wiki:
* who can read and edit it
* which extensions and skins it has
* what it looks like

It takes about 2-3 minutes, and everything here can be changed later at [[Special:ManageWiki]].
